## Executive Summary

Sahaya Savari F (known publicly as Sahaya Savari) is an AI Engineer, Python Developer, and Full Stack Developer
currently pursuing a Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Artificial Intelligence at St. Joseph's College (Autonomous),
Tiruchirappalli (Trichy), Tamil Nadu, India.

He builds practical Machine Learning models, Python data science pipelines, React and Next.js web
applications with TypeScript, and client-side offline tools. His portfolio emphasizes shipped work,
verified hackathon championships, and solid engineering discipline.

## Project Specifications

### 1. NelSync AI — AI Paddy Procurement Optimization Layer (Overall Champion)
- **Type**: Agricultural Logistics Optimization
- **Status**: Overall Champion — AIxcelerate 2026 Hackathon (66 teams)
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Logistics Optimization
- **Architecture**: Four-stage procurement optimization framework: Stage 1 (Predict regional arrivals), Stage 2 (Optimize center capacity), Stage 3 (Schedule delivery slots), and Stage 4 (Monitor center flow).
- **Key Milestones**: Stage 1: 95/100 (Rank 2); Stage 2: Top 48 MVP; Final: Top 12, 3-minute pitch and live Q&A victory. Built by team of four led by Jeeva Loganathan.
- **My Contribution**: Built the first pitch deck, drove research behind the final presentation, coordinated the team, and led Q&A defense.
- **Project Overview**: https://sahayasavari.dev/projects/nelsync-ai

### 2. VibeCraft 2026 (NeuraGenZers) — Dual Campus Web Suite (Winner, 5th of 110 Teams)
- **Type**: Campus Web Applications
- **Status**: Winner (5th Place of 110 Teams) — SRM IST Trichy YUVA'26
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS v4, Recharts 3, Gemini API, Vercel
- **Architecture**: Combined dual-app platform: Round 1 Attendance Predictor & Planner (75% threshold, detention detection, OD simulator) + Round 2 Free Class Locator & Smart Search Floor Manager (room grid, filters, natural-language search).
- **Data Scope**: 13 sections, 120 OCR-verified subject records.
- **My Role**: Web development, deployment on Vercel, and final presentation deck.
- **Live URL**: https://neuragenzers.vercel.app/

### 3. PrepMind AI — Web-Based Exam Prep & Practice Platform
- **Type**: EdTech Practice Application
- **Status**: Live
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel
- **Architecture**: Web exam prep platform with topic-based MCQ practice, interactive study tools, AI tutoring, and learner progress tracking. Includes deterministic fallback practice questions when AI responses are unavailable.
- **Live URL**: https://prep-weblearning.vercel.app/
- **Project Overview**: https://sahayasavari.dev/projects/prepmind-ai

### 4. Daily Spark — Offline-First Habit Tracker
- **Type**: Productivity Application
- **Status**: Live
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, IndexedDB, Capacitor Android
- **Architecture**: Client-heavy Progressive Web App (PWA) with Capacitor support for Android. Data structures
  persist locally in IndexedDB and sync through React Context API. No server-side backend required.
- **Key Features**: Offline habit tracking, IndexedDB persistence, streak analytics, Capacitor Android build.
- **Challenge**: Handling date-time streak calculation across timezones entirely client-side without a server.
- **Project Overview**: https://sahayasavari.dev/projects/daily-spark
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/sahaya-savari/daily-spark

### 4. Portfolio Website — AI Engineer SPA
- **Type**: Web Engineering & SPA Architecture
- **Status**: Live
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 7, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS v4, Firebase Hosting
- **Architecture**: Single Page Application with static HTML pre-rendering across 9 public routes via
  scripts/prerender-seo.js. Manual Vite chunk splitting isolates heavy libraries. IntersectionObserver-based
  lazy loading preserves 60fps scroll performance. Firebase Hosting edge CDN with security headers and
  1-year immutable cache policies for static assets.
- **Key Features**: Custom glassmorphism design system, HLS video streaming, Schema.org JSON-LD entity graph,
  AI-discoverability architecture (llms.txt, llms-full.txt), static pre-rendering pipeline.
- **Live Site**: https://sahayasavari.dev
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/sahaya-savari/portfolio
